title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 10.6 Area: Calculate the area of triangles.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 10.6 Area: Calculate the area of triangles.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "10.6 Area", prints these objectives: "Calculate the area of triangles." "Calculate the area of quadrilaterals." "Calculate the area of other polygons." "Calculate the area of circles.". This card reports that page.
